subject: Execution runway: confirmation of MAP milestones and start cadence
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@brightretail.com>, procurement@brightretail.com
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Execution runway: confirmation of MAP milestones and start cadence

Hi Elena / BrightRetail procurement team —

Attaching the latest mutual action plan (MAP_BrightRetail_v3.xlsx) and a working SOW (Statement_of_Work_BR_v1.pdf). High-level asks for this thread:
- Confirm the internal approval gate(s) and the estimated routing time for signatures (legal -> procurement -> finance).
- Confirm whether DocuSign is acceptable and whether you need an internal PO ahead of signature.
- Confirm target production start week (we’ve tentatively held 2026-06-01).

Proposed timing from our side: if signatures are completed by 2026-05-28 we can hit a 2026-06-01 kickoff with the standard onboarding ramp (2-week integration window + pilot). If signatures slip beyond 05/28 we’ll need to shift the start by one week per business-day delay to preserve engineering capacity.

Neha (CS) and Marissa (Contracts) are cc’d to keep the path moving. Please share any procurement constraints or preferred signer windows — happy to lock into a mutual timeline.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0199

Attachments: MAP_BrightRetail_v3.xlsx, Statement_of_Work_BR_v1.pdf
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@brightretail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightretail.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 11:37:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Execution runway: confirmation of MAP milestones and start cadence

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for sending these over. Quick responses from procurement + legal side:
- DocuSign is preferred and fine for signatures.
- Procurement will need the final SOW and a one-page pricing summary for our PO team. Please add a "bill-to" contact on the SOW and a payment term line (standard is Net 45).
- We have an internal vendor-risk gate that requires a SOC 2 addendum signed before production data flows. That typically adds 3 business days once legal has reviewed.
- Target start 2026-06-01 is workable if we receive the final docs by next Wed, 05/19; otherwise we push to the following week.

I’ve attached our procurement checklist for reference (procurement_requirements_BR.pdf). I’ll follow up with the name of the finance approver.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Digital Experience, BrightRetail
elena.rossi@brightretail.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Execution runway: confirmation of MAP milestones and start cadence

Jonas —
Thanks for the heads up. Quick notes from CS perspective:
- We can compress the onboarding plan if BrightRetail agrees to a short pilot (1 week) with production throttles in place. That would allow a soft-start 06/01 with a controlled token cap.
- I’ll prepare the onboarding runbook and two template kickoff dates (06/01 and 06/08) to give the procurement team flexibility.
- Risk: if SOC 2 addendum review takes the full 3 business days concurrently with legal redlines, we may still need to delay. Suggest we pre-send the SOC 2 addendum to legal to cut one step.

I’ll coordinate with Marissa on any contractual changes.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2026 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Execution runway: confirmation of MAP milestones and start cadence

Folks —
I reviewed the SOW and the MAP. A few legal housekeeping items to accelerate routing:
1) Add a one-paragraph SOC 2 addendum (I drafted SOC2_Addendum_BR.pdf) and include it as an exhibit — that should satisfy their vendor-risk team.
2) Pricing summary: Jonas, please produce a one-page pricing summary with the line items and payment term (Net 45) so procurement can create the PO in parallel.
3) Signature path: we prefer DocuSign with the following signer order: BrightRetail Legal -> BrightRetail Finance -> Redwood Contracts. That path allows us to countersign the same envelope to avoid multiple rounds.

Operationally, to preserve the 06/01 start target we need: final SOW + pricing summary + signed SOC 2 addendum in DocuSign by EOD 05/28. If any of those are delayed beyond EOD 05/28, recommend we slide start to the week of 06/08 to avoid a rushed integration.

I’ll attach the drafted SOC 2 addendum and can push redlines quickly once they return comments.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@brightretail.com>, procurement@brightretail.com
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Execution runway: confirmation of MAP milestones and start cadence

Elena / Procurement —

Thanks for the quick review and the checklist. Per Marissa and Neha’s notes I’ve:
- Attached a one-page pricing summary and updated the SOW with a bill-to block and Net 45 term.
- Attached the SOC2_Addendum_BR.pdf as Marissa requested.
- Created a DocuSign envelope for the SOW + SOC2 addendum: https://www.docusign.com/exec/BR-HS42317-signature (please confirm receipt).

Final ask: can you confirm the internal finance approver and whether they will sign in the DocuSign envelope or require a separate PO before signature? If DocuSign signing is confirmed and we receive completed envelope by 2026-05-28 EOD, Redwood will commit to the 2026-06-01 soft start with a 1-week throttled pilot. If the envelope completes after 05/28, we will move the start to 2026-06-08 to preserve engineering schedules.

Looking forward to locking dates — I’ll standby for the finance name and any redline feedback.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Attachments: pricing_summary_1p_BR.pdf, updated_SOW_BR_v1.1.pdf, SOC2_Addendum_BR.pdf
